title: Degree-zero direct-image comparison is compatible with coefficient restriction
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes, $\varphi:A\to B$ a homomorphism of finite commutative rings, $F$ a sheaf of $A_X$-modules and $G$ a sheaf of $B_X$-modules on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $u:F\to\operatorname{Res}_\varphi G$ be an $A_X$-linear morphism. Use the K-injective derived direct images $Rf_*^A,Rf_*^B$ and the canonical restriction-of-scalars comparison $c: Rf_*^A\operatorname{Res}_\varphi\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Res}_\varphi Rf_*^B$ of [lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars]. Under the degree-zero augmentation isomorphisms $f_*F\cong\mathcal H^0(Rf_*^A(F[0]))$ and $f_*G\cong\mathcal H^0(Rf_*^B(G[0]))$ supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-left-exact-injective-resolution-degree-zero], the morphism
$$\mathcal H^0\bigl(c_{G[0]}\circ Rf_*^A(u[0])\bigr):\mathcal H^0(Rf_*^A(F[0]))\longrightarrow\mathcal H^0(\operatorname{Res}_\varphi Rf_*^B(G[0]))$$
is the underived map $f_*u:f_*F\to f_*\operatorname{Res}_\varphi G=\operatorname{Res}_\varphi f_*G$ [def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image]. Here restriction of scalars is exact, so commutes with $\mathcal H^0$, and the augmentation identifications are those obtained from nonnegative injective resolutions. Thus the comparison retains the actual section map, not merely its source and target objects.

proof.text: Write R=f_*^B, T=f_*^A, and r,s for exact scalar restriction on X,Y. The recorded coefficient comparison is inverse to the derived mate m. The underived mate is the identity R s = r T, because both direct images act by the same sectionwise pullback. Apply the proved derived-mate factorization on a complex K: s_D(eta_R(K)) followed by m and RT of the localization comparison equals the localization comparison for s followed by eta_T(rK).

proof.text: Specialize this factorization to the complex G[0]. The inverse termwise-single comparison for a composite R s is the inverse single comparison for s followed by s of that for R; check degree zero by cancelling the single-object isomorphisms, and all other degrees vanish. Use the exact functor single/localization equations and naturality of eta_T to obtain v_G followed by m at G[0] and RT of the single-restriction comparison equals single of the cached underived coefficient square followed by the canonical single-object unit for T at rG. Here v_G is the inverse single comparison for s followed by s_D of the canonical single-object unit for R.

proof.text: Since m and the single-restriction comparison are isomorphisms, cancel them to identify the T-unit at rG followed by RT of the inverse single comparison and the forward coefficient comparison with v_G. Naturality of the T single-object unit on u:F -> rG then gives the augmentation square: the T-unit at F followed by the displayed derived morphism equals single(f_*u) followed by v_G.

proof.text: Apply the canonical zeroth-homology unit identities, including exact postcomposition by s, from lem-kun-right-derived-single-h0. They identify the two vertical maps of the augmentation square with the single/H0 isomorphisms after the exact canonical H0 identifications used in the statement. Apply H0, cancel these isomorphisms, and use their naturality to conclude that the normalized morphism is f_*u. Expanding the exact-postcomposition H0 isomorphism yields precisely the stated augmentation and restriction/homology factors.
